# w3m / fuzz_conv

w3m's own fuzz target `fuzz_conv` ([source](source/fuzz-conv.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over w3m (tats/w3m at ee66aabc).

input split at NULs into <from-charset> \0 <to-charset> \0 <text>; charsets guessed by name, then wc_Str_conv_with_detect converts the text; result freed unread (no to->from roundtrip).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against w3m at commit ee66aabc.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch w3m` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_conv.plain` | 846,872 | `5f622fd36dca68dc75fa6e72d8ce169da0fab4ecf1f057148a85528ff0709ac5` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_conv.ubsan` | 869,656 | `7043935532a05a47308ac474d26fab7bfbe8e57d2bd2d95ba9bdb489ffa4d202` |
| asan | `fuzz_conv.asan` | 1,656,424 | `fa528f4e78251921de6aaa7b6e5136a076a7ec0343b46e67315d8092255b1b21` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_conv.asan-ubsan` | 1,693,832 | `fc53e11365186c6387ea13e21952099813e5e0e762b9311136181aba17089ac0` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgc.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgc.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgc.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libgc.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
